admission_evidence.completeness_rule: Ranged official archive must contain mode 2 train and mode 3 tram ZIPs with routes, stops, trips and stop_times; each requested byte range, ZIP checksum and referenced ID must validate. feed_info is optional in the upstream archive.

notes: Official schedule ZIP is about 275 MB and updated weekly or as needed. The connector fetches only train/tram mode members via validated byte ranges, deriving an archive revision from the HTTP validator and preserving Last-Modified as source_updated_at. Current upstream mode ZIPs omit feed_info, so timetable valid_from/valid_to remain unknown. Sparse stop_times represent complete route/stop associations but not complete trip/stop membership; trip-specific alert joins must fail closed. Fixtures are test-only. Source remains a review_required candidate until access and reuse admission.
